newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela moderates '97 growth estimate to 3.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela moderates '97 growth estimate to 3.3 pct.

text.p: Venezuela expects its economy to grow 3.3 percent this year, compared to a 1.6 percent contraction last year, Finance Ministry figures showed.
Non-oil gross domestic product is seen growing by 2.0 percent, while the oil economy ratchets up by 6.9 percent, according to a Finance Ministry document obtained by Reuters.
The new figures compare to earlier government estimates of four percent-plus growth for the economy as a whole, broken down into non-oil growth of 4.2 percent and oil sector growth of 4.9 percent.
Total exports are also seen growing to $21.4 billion by year-end from some $20.7 billion last year, helping feed growth in international reserves to over $20 billion.
Last year, foreign reserves rose $5.5 billion to end at $15.179 billion, largely due to high international oil prices.
